name: glycerin + hypromellose + polyethylene glycol 400
uses: Uses • for protection against further irritation • for temporary relief of burning and irritation due to dryness of the eye
otcwarn: Do not use this product if solution changes color or becomes cloudy Stop use and ask a doctor if you experience • eye pain • changes in vision • continued redness or irritation of the eye, or if the condition worsens or persists for more than 72 hours
